# v0.3.0

- Adds hosted documentation, a complete synthetic demo and local previews of group pages alongside the demo.
- Upgrades to stare 0.7, including support for timezone-free GLANCE paper timestamps.
- Fixes DOI resolution from curated registries and preserves CSV cell line endings during saved-HTML replay.
- Improves filtering performance, keyboard/accessibility behavior and download/recovery guidance.
- Adds coverage summaries on PRs, advisory public-API checks, browser failure diagnostics and package-content checks.

## Upgrading from 0.2.0

Generated snapshots now record generator identity instead of numeric schema versions. Structural validation remains strict; missing or differing generator metadata warns rather than rejecting valid data. Legacy schema-version fields are ignored. Rebuild unsupported inputs using the documented workflow, and preserve custom citation entries and provenance.

Python 3.13+ remains required. Documented support limits still apply.
